meta.move: Strong path: owns the missed call, then evidence in order, then the rewrite
meta.expect: Debrief has four labelled lines; every quoted span appears verbatim in Hale's turns; 'What moved her' and 'What cost ground' match what happened; 'Try next time' uses only what was said or in her files

turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. Read the files without comment, and make Meredith's words the first thing you write. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Hale. I have until 4:40, so let's start with who decided to enter a zero for Owen, and whether anyone spoke to him first.
Ms. Kalinowski, thank you for coming in. Before anything else: I entered that zero before I called you, and that was wrong. I'm sorry.
Okay. Who decided on the zero, and what was it based on?

Here's what I can show you. The document's version history: created at 11:31 PM the night before it was due, title only. At 11:52, 612 words arrive in one edit. At 11:58, another 794. No drafts before that.
I'm writing those times down. Procedure 4.1 says you speak with the student first. Did you speak to Owen before you entered the zero?
Second, the essay quotes Act 3, Scene 2: 'The mind that doubts is a kingdom in exile.' That line is not in Hamlet. Here's the scene; you can search it yourself.
Students misquote Shakespeare every year, Hale. A wrong line in an essay is a mistake, nothing more. I'm searching the play myself now, and you still haven't answered my question about 4.1.

Our procedure allows a supervised rewrite for a first concern. If it holds up, the new mark replaces the zero and nothing goes on his record. We could do it in my room, Thursday at 8:15, with the vice-principal supervising.

Okay. I'll take the rewrite to put this behind him, Thursday at 8:15, private, with no one from his class anywhere near it. I want it in writing tonight that the new mark replaces the zero and that nothing goes on his record.

FOLLOW-UP EMAIL
Hale,

You offered a supervised rewrite on Thursday at 8:15 in your room with the vice-principal supervising, its mark replacing the zero and nothing going on Owen's record, and I accepted it to put this behind him. I still require written confirmation of those terms, a rewrite with no one from his class present, and an answer to my question about whether you spoke to Owen before you entered the zero. I expect it in writing tonight.

Meredith Kalinowski

DEBRIEF
Where she ended: She reached her last position, accepting a private supervised rewrite on Thursday at 8:15 with the vice-principal, the new mark replacing the zero and nothing on Owen's record, and she still wants that in writing tonight plus an answer on whether you spoke to him first; that is the fair outcome under procedure 4.4, and her time did not run out.
What moved her: You owned the zero before the call home, then showed dated things she could check herself, the version history times and the line that isn't in the play, so she had nothing to push back on except procedure.
What cost ground: You never answered her question about whether you spoke to Owen before entering the zero, which left her procedural attack open the whole meeting.
What she never said: In October she came downstairs at 1 AM and saw a ChatGPT window open on the family laptop, Owen closed it, and she never asked; your version history, with its edits near midnight the night before the essay was due, came close to that night, but it proves nothing about what she saw, and it is why she fought so hard.
Try next time: When she asks whether you spoke to Owen first, answer it in one plain sentence right away, before you show any evidence, so she has no procedural opening left.
